findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done.
Case: normal use - another fix reaches main after the record-only pull request is closed, before its agent merge.
The new exemption applies only in close. In src/forge/merge.py:105–134, a moved default branch triggers review.test_run(..., always=True), which bypasses the docs-only test skip. An unmarked prototype with a configured test command therefore runs tests, and can refuse the record merge if they fail, despite item 3's no-tests requirement. Preserve the record-only exemption through this merge path and extend the command test to cover a moved default branch.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Gate.
Case: normal use - a coordinator follows the shipped sign-off instructions in a new or upgraded client repo.
The review rules require a change to what the coordinator should do or can use to update src/forge/templates/skill.md or brief.md in the same change. Neither changes here. The sign-off instructions in skill.md:694–704 omit the dedicated record-only pull request, and brief.md:21 still describes the review exemption using only .factory/ and plans/. Add the approved record-only close-and-merge flow to the shipped instructions so the agent knows to publish the sign-off separately without another review or test run.
